notes.paint_500_marks: was 5 ms before measuring; measured 6 to 11 ms at 4x CPU (1.5 to 3 ms real) with CSS highlights, so the gate is one frame (16 ms) at 4x
notes.marks_panel_2000: measured 95 to 106 ms median at 4x CPU; 120 ms at 4x is about 30 ms real, inside the 100 ms RAIL response target
notes.open_book_2000_marks: time to the text; marks_shown_2000 is time to the marks, which follow the text
notes.ideas_scroll_frame_p95: a frame is 16.7 ms at 60 Hz; the gate is the 95th slowest frame of a full scroll through 1,000 books at 4x CPU on a phone-size window, so a miss means dropped frames. A real Android phone is still to be measured
notes.ideas_graph_ready_1000_books: was 5000; 1.6 s at 4x CPU once the layout ran on a copy sigma does not watch (3.0 s before)
notes.initial_js: was 80; 31.2 KB after the reader, secondary screens and the Spanish catalog became their own files (Nov 2026). Counts the entry and every chunk it preloads
